Yes, you can likely restore it. Per `restoring-a-deleted-repository.md` (§"About repository restoration"): a deleted repository can be restored within 90 days (up to 1 hour after deletion for it to become available), unless it was part of a non-empty fork network.

To restore: go to Settings → Repositories → "Deleted repositories" (personal account) or your org's settings → Repositories → deleted repos (org-owned), then click Restore. Note: team permissions are not restored automatically.
